credits.title: Crazy Kalyanam
credits.overview: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

credits.title: Eesha
credits.overview: Four friends set out to challenge blind beliefs, only to be drawn into a mysterious spiritual encounter that changes their lives forever.

credits.title: Raju Weds Rambai
credits.overview: Raju Weds Rambai is inspired by a real story of a carefree band drummer whose love for a compounders daughter triggers a clash of ego and honour, turning their sweet village romance into an emotional journey filled with conflict, pain, and ultimately redemption.
